main_text.head: IACOBI KIMEDONCII, FILII. CASTIGATIONES, IN THEOPHYLACTVM.
In quaestiones physicas.
main_text.p: IN proœmio dialogi. pag.1. lin.21 Μαλὶν ἐγὼ Συμεὼν[?]) Malim ego, Συμεὼν. moneat me illa, quae precedunt proxime; καὶ πρὸς τὸ ἑξῆς[?] Dicitur enim hic dialogus coram collegio philosophorum aliquot, quasi in theatro, & vt a metaphora non discedat, addit author πρὸς ἐξῆς[?] epistola prima & ut circa-da: τερπλίζεσ γῦνὸ μελαῶ̈ς βῆμα[?] alio interprete ad locum hunc non est opus, nec melior esse posset. Βῆμα appellat pulpitum, ἥν Συμπλίλη̈ quo loco erat altus in orchestra quinque pedes, forma mensa, sive altaris, unde Bacchi ea ara. Suidas in voce Σκηνὴ &c. ἐςιμὴ̈ ὀρχήςραν Σωμὸς Διονύσῳ, ὡς καλεῖ[?] θυμέλην. Iulii Pollucis lib. XVIII. cap. XLVII. Thymelici autem erant musici (cenici, qui in organis & lyris, & citharis praecinebant. Et dicti Thymelici, quod olim in orchestra stantes cantabant super pulpitum, quod Thymele vocabatur & cap. XLIV. Orchestra autem pulpitus erat scenae, vbi saltator agere poterat, aut duo inter se disputare. Ibi enim poetae comoedi & tragoedi ad certamen concurrebant &c. Facit hoc quod in eadem metaphora etiam postea perseueret, Naemilla.

page.notes: The Greek is set in small type and only partly legible at this scan. Its exact letters are uncertain and are marked [?] where doubtful, especially the opening Greek words of the first line and the Greek after "Suidas in voce". The Latin is read with confidence except where a word is italic, but the italic commentary lines are in the column, not in a margin, so they are kept as <i>. The stray mark below the text and the ornamental border are not printed text. The edge of the facing page at the left is excluded.
